name: roleweave
description: RoleWeave — file tree is the org chart. Electron shell + local control plane for digital-employee workspaces.
author: RoleWeave Contributors

scripts.package:staging:macos: npm run clean:package:staging && npm run build && npm run build:renderer && npm run prepare:updater && npm run prepare:electron:staging && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64 --dir --publish never
scripts.package:staging:windows: npm run clean:package:staging && npm run build && npm run build:renderer && npm run prepare:updater && npm run prepare:electron:staging && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.package:dist:macos: npm run clean:package:staging && npm run build && npm run build:renderer && npm run prepare:updater && npm run prepare:electron:staging && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never -c.publish.provider=github -c.publish.owner=bytefolk -c.publish.repo=roleweave -c.directories.output=release/dist
scripts.package:dist:windows: npm run clean:package:staging && npm run build && npm run build:renderer && npm run prepare:updater && npm run prepare:electron:staging && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never -c.publish.provider=github -c.publish.owner=bytefolk -c.publish.repo=roleweave -c.directories.output=release/dist
scripts.package:macos:unsigned: npm run package:staging:macos && npm run verify:package:macos
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run prepare:updater && npm run test:scripts && npm run typecheck:ui && npm run test:ui && node --test --test-timeout=120000 "apps/server/dist/test/*.test.js" && npm run typecheck:renderer && npm run test:renderer && npm run test:desktop-main && npm run security:check
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build && npm run build:renderer && npm run prepare:updater && electron apps/desktop/src/main.js
